posts.cooked:
Hello All,

I wanted to introduce myself, my name is Dennis. I got introduced to Sentinels of the Multiverse about 3 weeks ago and I was hooked. I have since then I have Purchased Sentinels of the Multiverse: Enhanced Edition, Rook City & Infernal Relics, Shattered Timelines, and Vengeance. And have got all the Mini-Expansion Cards. I wanted to share my Storage Solution.

First off thanks to Spiff for all his great stuff: http://spiffworld.com/sotm/

On the tachyon - super scientific - burst tracker you’re missing the little white triangle.

 

So I am using: 2000x Ultra Pro Standard Card Sleeves (Penny Sleeves) 20 Packs

http://www.newegg.com/Product/Product.aspx?Item=9SIA3P317B5929

Vaultz Locking Storage Chest, Black:

http://www.walmart.com/ip/32285825?www=true&productRedirect=true

Avery Slide and View Expanding File Folder:

http://www.walmart.com/ip/Avery-Slide-and-View-Expanding-File-Folder/33167257

The case is a Vaultz:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/0BwHM5al0PayfOFlOekRkVnh5ems/view?usp=sharing

And as it has room for some expansion using Spiff’s boxes. Here is a Pic:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/0BwHM5al0PayfTnpoR0NVXzB0ZEE/view?usp=sharing

Then I use the Expanding file for all my Hit Point Trackers:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/0BwHM5al0PayfNUdKVEY5WVhYTFU/view?usp=sharing

And it goes right on top:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/0BwHM5al0PayfeUc3SFFCeEF5cmM/view?usp=sharing

Closes up tight:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/0BwHM5al0PayfY3cxeENaNWhtZHM/view?usp=sharing

And has a Handle on each side:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/0BwHM5al0PayfYjVUcVh2Yy1qZ0E/view?usp=sharing

 

 

So that is what I use Penny sleeves $17; Case $30 ; Folder $8; so for around $55 dollars a good Transporting Solution.

 

Just need to get Wrath of the Cosmos, and the Villain Oversized Cards, and I will have great set, thanks for the fun GTG.

 

Dennis

Since I used Spiff’s Boxes, even if you laid them down lengthwise you still can’t see the dividers. So they are not very effective.  But if you don’t use Spiff’s Boxes then you can also put 2 of the Big game boxes (EE and Veng for example) Side by side and still have room left over for your extras. I didn’t show it but there is also a small mesh bag on the top perfect size for the Oversized cards.
